installApp.title: Download CapyMeal for Android
installApp.intro: CapyMeal wants to be an app for everyone, so besides using it from the browser you can install it directly on your Android, without going through the Play Store. We're distributing it this way, instead of publishing it there, so it stays 100% free: we don't charge anyone, we don't show ads, we don't sell your data, and there's nothing hidden inside. The only purpose of this app is to help you keep your meal diary.
installApp.downloadError: We couldn't download the file. Check your connection and try again.
installApp.warningsBody: Since this version doesn't come from the Play Store, your Android will show you a couple of security warnings when installing it. This happens to {emphasis} app installed this way, it's not a sign that something's wrong: it just means Android doesn't recognize the Play Store as the source. Below we walk you through what to do with each one.
installApp.step1: Tap the button above. The file downloads as {filename}.
installApp.step2: Open the downloaded file (from the download notification, or from your Downloads folder).
installApp.step3: A first warning will show up, something like {warning}, with a {settings} button. Tap it, turn on {trustSource}, and go back.
installApp.step5: A second warning from {playProtect} may show up, something like {blockedMsg}. Tap {moreDetails} and then {installAnyway}.
installApp.step5BlockedMsg: App blocked to protect your device
installApp.step6: When it's done, tap {open}. All set!
installApp.updatesBody: The app's content (your diary, your meals) is always up to date on its own, because it connects live to the same place as the web version. If we ever release a new version of the installer itself, you'll need to come back to this page and repeat these steps with the new {filename}.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.whoBody: CapyMeal is a personal meal diary. If you have any questions about your data or this policy, you can write to us at {email}.
privacy.dataItem1: Your name and email, to identify your account.
privacy.dataItem2: Your password, always encrypted, we never see it in plain text.
privacy.dataItem3: Your diary content: what you write for each meal and in "Today's memory."
privacy.dataItem4: Your avatar choice (a Capi illustration, or your Gravatar photo if you have one linked to your email).
privacy.useBody: Only to give you the service: saving and showing you your own diary, letting you export it as a PDF, and emailing you if you ask to reset your password. We don't sell or share your data with third parties for advertising.
privacy.thirdPartyGravatar: if you choose to show your Gravatar photo as your avatar, your email is used (encrypted) to look up that image on gravatar.com.
privacy.thirdPartyEmail: we use an external email service only to send you the password-reset email.
privacy.thirdPartyHosting: the app and your information live with cloud hosting providers (server, database, and website), hired so we can offer you the service.
privacy.retentionHeading: How long we keep your data
privacy.retentionBody: For as long as your account exists. If you delete it, your account and your whole diary are permanently and immediately erased: no copy is kept.
privacy.rightsHeading: Your rights: access, correct, or delete
privacy.rightsBody: You can view and edit your whole diary at any time from the app. To delete your account and all your data, go to {settingsPath}. If you can't access your account, you can also ask us to delete it by writing to {email}.
privacy.minorsBody: CapyMeal isn't aimed at children. We don't knowingly collect data from minors.
privacy.changesBody: If this policy changes in any meaningful way, we'll update the date above.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.whatBody: CapyMeal is a personal meal diary, meant for personal, non-commercial use. By creating an account, you agree to these terms. If you have questions, write to us at {email}.
terms.accountBody: You're responsible for keeping your password safe and for everything that happens in your account. If you create your account with Google, that provider handles verifying your identity. CapyMeal isn't aimed at minors.
terms.contentBody: What you write in your diary is yours. We only use it to give you the service (storing it, showing it to you, letting you export it): we never sell it or use it for commercial purposes. More detail in the {privacyLink}.
terms.acceptableUseBody: We ask that you use CapyMeal in good faith: don't try to breach its security, don't use someone else's account without permission, and don't use the service for illegal purposes.
terms.asIsBody: CapyMeal is a prototype in active development (v0.1). We do our best to keep it available and your data safe, but we can't guarantee the service will be free of errors or interruptions. We're not liable for indirect losses arising from your use of the app.
terms.closingBody: You can delete your account whenever you want from {settingsPath}; your whole diary gets permanently erased. We can also suspend or close accounts that break these terms.
terms.changesBody: If these terms change in any meaningful way, we'll update the date above.
